import threading

    print(f"{robot['name']} is going to {obj}.")

    print(f"{robot['name']} is opening {obj}.")

def CloseObject(robot, obj):
    print(f"{robot['name']} is closing {obj}.")

def SwitchOn(robot, obj):
    print(f"{robot['name']} is switching on {obj}.")

def SwitchOff(robot, obj):
    print(f"{robot['name']} is switching off {obj}.")

def PickupObject(robot, obj):
    print(f"{robot['name']} is picking up {obj}.")

def PutObject(robot, obj, receptacle):
    print(f"{robot['name']} is putting {obj} in/on {receptacle}.")

# Define the tasks

    # SubTask 1: Fill the Bathtub with warm water

    SwitchOn(robot, 'Faucet')
    time.sleep(5)  # Simulate time taken to fill the bathtub
    SwitchOff(robot, 'Faucet')
    CloseObject(robot, 'Faucet')

    PutObject(robot, 'Towel', 'TowelHolder')
